answer: A work-and-stake gate stops cheap identity farming: each agent must lock a refundable bond and complete verifiable, time-bound work before it can trade. Creating one identity is easy, but creating ten thousand is not: the bond ties up capital, the work consumes compute, and bad behaviour slashes the bond. Like crossing a canyon on a narrow bridge, the path cannot be widened by copying yourself; a spiral of fake accounts only multiplies the cost, while honest agents keep a clear horizon of reputation that fakes cannot borrow.
